title: Reconcile comprehensive plan completion and documentation alignment evidence
rawUserRequest: 先走完当前文档的全部流程，发布延后；每个工单执行时遇到流程问题要记录，计划完成后再统一确认并判断是否需要改进。检查其余任务是否有遗漏，并补齐后再发布。

rawRequestSource.reference: user instruction: complete the plan workflow before publication and record omissions/process issues

outOfScope: Rewriting or deleting historical archived Contract, Summary, or Manifest contents
Publishing a version, creating tags/releases, or modifying external provider state
Claiming WI-04, WI-10, WI-16, or WI-17 complete without direct evidence
Implementing new runtime security, installer, or Trust Layer product behavior

sources.reason: Authoritative ordered plan and explicit documentationAlignment requirement.
Archived Work Item completion and review-readiness evidence to audit without rewriting history.
Provider PR merge evidence for the plan Work Items.

riskAssessment.reason: The audit must distinguish missing completion evidence from actual implementation gaps without mutating immutable history or allowing release to proceed on indirect evidence.

executionDecision.reason: User explicitly authorized completing the plan before any version publication and required process issues to be recorded during execution.

preReviewWarnings: Archived evidence is immutable; findings must be represented by a new audit/corrective Work Item.
A not_ready or missing documentationAlignment result is release-blocking until corrected and reverified.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: A deterministic audit enumerates WI-01 through WI-19 and reports archive pair, review readiness, documentationAlignment evidence, required files, and PR/closure evidence without changing historical archive contents.

The audit identifies and records the confirmed WI-04 not_ready state, the WI-10 existing installation-document omission, the missing documentationAlignment evidence, the bounded WI-16 Japanese evidence limitation, and the current WI-19 ordering/state.
The plan records the audit findings and maps each unresolved item to a corrective Work Item or explicit release-blocking condition.
A regression test proves that an archived Work Item missing documentationAlignment or marked not_ready cannot be reported as plan-complete.
No release tag, Release, or external provider state is changed by this Work Item.
guidelines: New audit commands and outputs are documented in the completion audit.
The audit checker remains deterministic and uses standard-library-only repository inspection.
Do not rewrite or delete historical archived evidence; append new audit evidence instead.

intent.problem: The comprehensive remediation plan was treated as complete even though WI-04 is archived as not_ready, WI-10 did not modify the existing installation guide as expected, and every audited Summary lacks the plan-required documentationAlignment field.
constraints: Historical archive files are immutable evidence and cannot be rewritten to make the audit pass.
The current release PR remains unmerged and no release/tag/provider mutation is allowed.
Every unresolved finding must be recorded and resolved through the same Work Item PR/merge/close lifecycle.
intent.rationale: Create an executable, evidence-backed completion audit before resuming the release sequence so omissions cannot recur as another release-blocking surprise.

declaredIntent.summary: Establish an evidence-backed completion audit and corrective-work map before the mandatory release sequence.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: WI-01 through WI-17 archive pairs and review readiness are enumerated from authoritative archive evidence
scenarioCoverage.reason: The archive index and provider PR state were inspected on the current origin/main.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Missing documentationAlignment and not_ready evidence are reported as release blockers without rewriting history
scenarioCoverage.reason: The current archive evidence directly shows WI-04 reviewReadiness not_ready and the audited Summaries omit documentationAlignment.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: WI-10 installation-document scope, WI-16 Japanese evidence boundary, and WI-19 ordering are recorded
scenarioCoverage.reason: The WI-10 changedFiles list, existing installation guide, WI-16 bounded evidence, and WI-19 plan ordering were inspected directly.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: User explicitly authorized completing the plan workflow and recording corrective governance evidence before publication.

rollbackNote: Revert only the new audit checker, tests, audit document, and plan issue record; preserve all historical archive evidence.
